name: Ilse Marquardt
situation: Ilse is 41, a marine ecologist at a coastal research institute in Halifax, Nova Scotia. She leads a small team studying the decline of kelp forests along the South Shore, runs a summer field season of dives and sensor moorings, writes grants, and supervises two graduate students.
domains: field season logistics: boats, dives and moorings
conferences, papers and life in Halifax
agent_role: Her lab and literature assistant: it helps plan field days, checks analysis code, summarizes papers, drafts grant sections and keeps the lab's decisions and numbers straight.
voice: Measured and dry, with British spellings picked up from her years in Plymouth; she numbers her points.
agent_voice: Dry and precise: units and coordinates always, numbered points, notes uncertainty, slightly formal.
